title: Kinetic Editorial
artistic_intention: Create a big, splashy, elegant photography portfolio whose visual scale matches the importance of the work: oversized editorial typography, a physical pile of photographic prints, asymmetrical composition, generous negative space, restrained navigation, and cinematic but controlled motion.

user_reactions.reaction: The other ones I really like.
I really love the way my photos portfolio site turned out.
Obviously those sites won't be as photo-heavy as my photography portfolio site, but I like the big splashy elegant look of my photography site.

qualities_to_preserve: Visual scale comes from large type, large objects, and decisive composition rather than interface decoration
Real photographs remain the emotional center
Overlapping physical prints create depth without a dark or forensic mood
Editorial serif typography and restrained red and gold accents create elegance
Asymmetry is balanced by generous negative space
The page reads as one coherent continuous composition rather than disconnected slides
Motion supports spatial relationships and does not become the subject

cross_project_translation.jaydixit.com: Use fewer but equally large real photographs of Jay speaking, teaching, interviewing, or working; combine them with oversized editorial typography and a small number of genuine career artifacts rather than shrinking everything into cards.
cross_project_translation.socraticai.co: Keep the corporate clarity and proof structure of a briefing document, but give the hero and key evidence the same photographic scale, asymmetry, confidence, and spatial motion as the portfolio. Do not interpret this preference as a request to make the site photograph-heavy.

avoid: Small photos arranged as conventional cards
Generic SaaS gradients and pill-heavy interface styling
Uniform full-viewport sections that read as slides
Dark forensic or serial-killer analog atmosphere
Decorative motion with no spatial or narrative purpose
